title: OECS Metadata Definitions
description: Defines provenance and compliance metadata for an OECS document: source documents the specification was derived from, certificates held by the product, and document-level bookkeeping.

source.description: A document or reference that the data in this specification instance was sourced from.

version.description: Version/revision identifier of the source document itself.

retrievedDate.description: Date this source was consulted/retrieved when compiling this specification.

certificateType.description: This same type list is used here, in hardware.certifications, and in software.protocols[].certifications. Place a certificate as close as possible to what it certifies: on the relevant protocol entry if it's protocol-specific (e.g. an OCPP conformance certificate), on hardware.certifications if it covers the hardware/enclosure as a whole (e.g. a safety or EMC certificate), and here only if it doesn't fit either (e.g. a company-wide quality management certification).

certificate.description: A certification, conformance test result, or regulatory approval held by the product.

standard.description: The standard or scheme the certificate attests to, e.g. 'IEC 61851-1', 'UL 2594', 'UN R100', 'OCPP 2.0.1 Certification', 'Common Criteria EAL2'.

jurisdiction.description: Region/country the certificate is valid for, e.g. 'EU', 'US', 'CN', 'global'.

documentInfo.description: Bookkeeping about this OECS document instance itself, as distinct from the product it describes.

createdBy.description: Person, team, or system that compiled this specification instance.

license.description: License under which this document is published, e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0'.

language.description: Primary BCP 47 language tag of the document content.

metadata.description: Complete metadata block: provenance, certificates, and document bookkeeping.
